jobs.title: Account Executive (Insurance)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go is a platform for building and deploying custom AI agents, made for the document-heavy work finance and insurance teams handle every day. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in. It runs on the latest models too, including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Have a look at what we're building for finance and insurance.

Most AI agents still behave like black boxes. They wander off-task, miss the context that matters, and make calls you can't check. Go Agents are different: predictable, transparent, and auditable at every step.

  • Build custom AI workflows with controlled analysis at every stage. Every output comes with citations and a full audit trail, so the human in the loop can see exactly how it got there.

  • The Context Graph makes all your data (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place, giving your agents the context to be properly useful. It's your institutional memory.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll be joining our Sales team in New York, reporting to Viky, our Head of Sales.

  • You’ll drive pipeline and win business selling V7 Go whilst focusing on a specific vertical (Insurance).

  • You’ll work closely with marketing, sales development, account management and our solution engineering team in order to get deals over the line.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • You’ll be running the full sales cycle for tailored solutions and generating pipelines proactively.

  • Multi-threading accounts by building strong business cases and cultivating multiple champions across technical and commercial stakeholders.

  • Becoming an AI product expert by earning trust as a strategic advisor who can confidently explain V7’s capabilities and the broader impact of AI in the era of multi-LLMs.

  • Owning your vertical like a CEO, taking the lead in shaping how V7 transforms a specific industry’s approach to AI, and driving our growth in that space.

Who you are

  • You’re a successful Account Executive with track record of strong performance early in your career (top 10%-20% of the sales org) quota attainment successfully selling in 100 < 30,000 FTE segment, typical deal sizes sold $30,000 - $250,000 ARR.

  • You love AI, including the applications of Large Language Models and GenAI.

  • You can develop and articulate an AI solution vision to technical and business stakeholders to match value proposition and business needs, as a consultative partner.

  • You have a Pipeline Generation mindset.

  • You love working in fast-paced, growing start-up environment and want ownership.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Backend)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

 

The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have

  • Reporting to Chris, our Engineering Manager, you’ll be working in the Go Engineering team.

  • You’ll work in a team of (eventually) 7 people and be given significant responsibility, not just for coding but also for testing, planning, and analysis.

  • You’ll set your own goals, plans, and metrics, focusing on impact and outcomes rather than task completion.

  • Engineers are expected to be self-starters who really strive for impact. This means proactively solving problems, seeking help when needed, and having a strong sense of product ownership.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Enabling foundation models to be applied to multimodal data at scale.

  • Helping to scale our platform to meet challenging multi tenant usage patterns.

  • Building a rich suite of APIs to power all of our internal systems and customer-facing products.

  • Shipping to production multiple times a day, working closely with Product and Design to solve customer problems.

Who you are

  • You’ll have experience with functional programming. Familiarity with Elixir is a plus, but other languages like Scala, GoLang, Node.js, Haskell, Clojure, and F# are also great.

  • Infrastructure management experience at scale; ideally you should be comfortable in using AWS and terraform.

  • An understanding of queue management and observability.

  • Experience with orchestration tools like Docker.

  • Knowledge of GenAI and prompt engineering.

  • Place the customer at the heart of everything you do.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

jobs.title: Product & Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The team you'll be joining and impact you'll have

  • You'll own how V7 looks and feels to the world, across both the marketing site and the product itself. This is a product and brand design role first: you'll be setting the visual direction, designing the product experience and making sure the two hang together.

  • Our design team is small and sits close to engineering. Designers here work directly with the people building the product, and the loop between a design decision and it appearing in the codebase is short.

  • A lot of this currently sits with contractors or is spread thinly across the team. You'll pull it in-house and become the person who owns the brand and the product's design language.

  • You'll help shape our design system and the front-end refactor that sits underneath it, defining the components and patterns everyone else builds on. Engineering will do the heavy lifting on implementation, but you'll be the one deciding what good looks like.

What you'll be doing from day one:

  • Own the marketing site end to end in Framer, including the parts most people skip: CMS collections, dynamic content, responsive behaviour and interaction states.

  • Design product UI against our design system, from early exploration through to polished, buildable specs, working alongside engineers rather than throwing designs over the wall.

  • Define motion and interaction: animation, empty and loading states, transitions, and the detail that makes a product feel finished. Where it's quicker to tweak it yourself in the codebase, you can.

  • Take on genuinely new surfaces that don't have a pattern yet, like visualising the Context Graph: nodes, edges, and how a knowledge graph should actually read on screen.

  • Run an AI-first workflow: exploring variants in Claude Design, generating specs in Cursor, using whatever tooling gets you from idea to something real fastest. Fast because of the tooling, not despite it.

Who you are

  • You're a product and brand designer with real craft. Your portfolio shows strong visual instincts and thoughtful product thinking, and you can hold a coherent direction across web, marketing and product.

  • You know Framer properly, CMS collections and all, and you can build a page that looks good and reads well without hand-holding, with the kind of animation and polish that lifts a brand.

  • You can work inside a design system: extending components, keeping things consistent, and knowing when something genuinely needs a new pattern versus reusing what's there.

  • You're comfortable enough around code that opening a pull request in Cursor or similar to fix a spacing issue or adjust a component doesn't scare you. That's a bonus, not the job. You're a designer who can get hands-on when it helps, not an engineer who happens to design.

  • You treat AI tooling as core to how you work, using it to amplify your output and move faster rather than keeping it at arm's length.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).


The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have

  • A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products.

  • We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work.

  • We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon

  • Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control.

What you’ll be doing from day one:

  • Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises.

  • Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day.

  • Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost.

  • Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation.

Who you are

  • Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud.

  • Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn).

  • A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers.

  • Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You'll join our go-to-market team as a forward deployed engineer, sitting at the intersection of sales and product in a company processing tens of millions of documents for customers across finance, insurance, and real estate.

  • V7 Go 4x-ed revenue last year, with 160%+ upsell into accounts. You'll help accelerate that trajectory by making sure every customer gets real value.

  • We run a lean, high-trust team where you'll work directly with AEs, engineers, and product to close complex deals and turn new logos into long-term champions.

  • Your work directly shapes how enterprises experience agentic AI for the first time and how quickly they believe in it.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Run technical discovery, design solutions, and lead POCs alongside Account Executives to close deals, then own onboarding to get customers to first value fast.

  • Build and implement workflows within V7 Go; combining prompt engineering, data pipelines, and integrations to solve real customer problems across document processing and more.

  • Act as the primary technical contact for accounts, handling complex challenges and spotting expansion opportunities as customers scale.

  • Juggle up to 10 concurrent projects while feeding customer insights back to product and engineering.

Who you are

  • You are a prototyper at heart with a gift of talking to customers, building relationships, and solving technical problems with repeatability.

  • You have experience in delivering Large Language Model projects with customers, including LLM API integration, up-to-speed knowledge of foundation models, solutions design/architecture, integrating different cloud providers, prompt engineering, and/or measuring AI accuracy.

  • You love coding with Python.

  • You can develop and articulate an AI solution vision to technical and business stakeholders, with customers and partners to match the value proposition to business needs.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.
